hints.title: Key Insight and Observation
hints.text: Group positive integers into blocks by digit length: 1 to 9 (9 digits), 10 to 99 (180 digits), etc.

hints.title: Algorithmic Strategy and State
hints.text: Subtract block capacities from k until identifying the target digit length group.

hints.title: Optimal Boundary and Processing
hints.text: Determine the exact target integer and extract the specific digit requested.

hints.title: Complete Implementation
hints.text:
```python
def findKthDigit(k: int) -> int:
    digit_len = 1
    count = 9
    start = 1
    while k > digit_len * count:
        k -= digit_len * count
        digit_len += 1
        count *= 10
        start *= 10
    num = start + (k - 1) // digit_len
    idx = (k - 1) % digit_len
    return int(str(num)[idx])
```

complexity.notes: Direct digit group subtraction and modular arithmetic evaluate in logarithmic time.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Building or iterating through the string directly exceeds memory and time.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Groups numbers by digit length and uses integer arithmetic to pinpoint the digit.
